fusions.name: Horns Lowered
fusions.desc: Rushes you at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and gores through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 13 damage to everything in the cone.

fusions.name: Yoke-Breaker
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Draught Strength

riders.text: more of you to get through

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises by 10, from silver your armour rises by 5%, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
